meta.name: KARTEX Phase B — Qdrant collection definitions
meta.embeddingContract: Default model bge-small-en-v1.5 (384d). Migration to a new model => new collection suffix _vN + dual-write + cutover. Vectors are a derived index; source of truth stays in Postgres.
meta.hybrid: Dense (Qdrant) + sparse/keyword (Postgres FTS) fused at query time (RRF).

collections.name: product_catalog_v1
collections.chunking: one vector per product (title + brand + category + key attributes); long descriptions truncated to 512 tokens
collections.filterStrategy: pre-filter on status=ACTIVE AND inStock=true AND pincode match before ANN
collections.retention: live; deleted/archived products are removed on catalog event

collections.name: recommendation_profiles_v1
collections.chunking: one vector per buyer rolling-interest profile

collections.name: knowledge_chunks_v1
collections.chunking: recursive 512-token chunks, 64-token overlap; metadata-tagged by source doc
collections.retention: versioned; superseded chunks deleted on re-ingest
